{
  "candidate_rtl": "`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 64 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 6 && W == 64) begin : fast64
    wire [7:0] group_valid;
    wire [7:0] group_enable;
    wire [7:0] code0;
    wire [7:0] code1;
    wire [7:0] code2;
    genvar g, b;
    for (g = 0; g < 8; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        wire [7:0] x;
        wire upper4;
        wire upper2;
        wire upper6;
        wire [2:0] local_code;
        assign x = input_unencoded[g*8 +: 8];
        assign group_valid[g] = |x;
        if (g == 7) begin : top_group
            assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
        end else begin : other_group
            assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[7:g+1]);
        end
        assign upper4 = |x[7:4];
        assign upper2 = |x[7:6];
        assign upper6 = |x[7:2];
        assign local_code[2] = upper4;
        assign local_code[1] = upper2 | ((~upper4) & (|x[3:2]));
        assign local_code[0] = x[7] | ((~upper2) & x[5]) |
                               ((~upper4) & x[3]) | ((~upper6) & x[1]);
        assign code0[g] = local_code[0] & group_enable[g];
        assign code1[g] = local_code[1] & group_enable[g];
        assign code2[g] = local_code[2] & group_enable[g];
        for (b = 0; b < 8; b = b + 1) begin : bits_out
            if (g == 0 && b == 0) begin : default_bit
                assign output_unencoded[0] = ~(|input_unencoded[63:1]);
            end else if (b == 7) begin : top_bit
                assign output_unencoded[g*8+b] = x[b] & group_enable[g];
            end else begin : other_bit
                assign output_unencoded[g*8+b] = x[b] &
                    (~(|x[7:b+1])) & group_enable[g];
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    assign output_encoded[2:0] = {|code2, |code1, |code0};
    assign output_encoded[5] = |group_valid[7:4];
    assign output_encoded[4] = (|group_valid[7:6]) |
        ((~(|group_valid[7:4])) & (|group_valid[3:2]));
    assign output_encoded[3] = group_valid[7] |
        ((~(|group_valid[7:6])) & group_valid[5]) |
        ((~(|group_valid[7:4])) & group_valid[3]) |
        ((~(|group_valid[7:2])) & group_valid[1]);
end else begin : general_implementation
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    genvar l, n;
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : msb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end
    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The reference propagates encoded data through a multilevel priority-multiplexer tree and then generates output_unencoded by decoding the resulting index. The serial encode-then-decode dependency is a likely maximum-arrival bottleneck.",
  "rewrite": "For the specified configuration, split the input into eight eight-bit groups. Compute local priority codes and higher-group suppression concurrently. Form the low index bits by OR-reducing enabled local codes, and compute the high index bits directly from group-valid signals. Generate one-hot outputs directly from local and group priority conditions, bypassing the encoded-index decoder. Retain the reference implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by eliminating the encoded-index-to-one-hot path and replacing cascaded encoded-data multiplexers with parallel reductions and priority terms. No numerical gain is claimed: SKY130HD mapping, constrained STA, and electrical verification have not been run.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "The rewrite adds parallel priority terms while removing the general one-hot decoder in the specialized configuration. Shared group-valid and local reduction signals limit duplication. Compliance with the 1713.518400um2 area cap requires mapped measurement; it is not established here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Purely combinational, with no added latency or state. For WIDTH=64 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, the highest asserted bit wins. An all-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=64'b1, matching the reference's unconditional shift behavior. Module ports, parameter declarations, signedness, and the original fallback truncation behavior are preserved. No assumptions are made about input data. Source and mapped equivalence remain to be checked."
}
